description: This file defines the AttendanceConfiguration class in the OrangeHRM Attendance module. It is a Data Transfer Object (DTO) that encapsulates permissions related to attendance management, including whether the user can change their current time, modify attendance, and if a supervisor can modify attendance.

classes.name: AttendanceConfiguration
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object that holds attendance-related permission flags for users and supervisors.

methods.name: canUserChangeCurrentTime
methods.description: Returns whether the user is allowed to change their current time.

methods.name: setCanUserChangeCurrentTime
methods.description: Sets whether the user is allowed to change their current time.

methods.name: canUserModifyAttendance
methods.description: Returns whether the user has permission to modify their attendance.

methods.name: setCanUserModifyAttendance
methods.description: Sets whether the user can modify their attendance.

methods.name: canSupervisorModifyAttendance
methods.description: Returns whether the supervisor can modify attendance for users.

methods.name: setCanSupervisorModifyAttendance
methods.description: Sets whether the supervisor can modify attendance for users.
